# Jeff Honforloco Photography — official site

> Jeff Honforloco is a professional photographer based in Providence, Rhode Island. This official site publishes his portfolio, service details, current starting prices and booking workflow. Travel availability is confirmed per project.

## Canonical identity

- Photographer: Jeff Honforloco
- Business: Jeff Honforloco Photography
- Official domain: https://jeffhonforlocophotos.com/
- Base: Providence, Rhode Island, United States

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://jeffhonforlocophotos.com/): Studio overview, featured work, reviews and booking path.
- [Portfolios](https://jeffhonforlocophotos.com/portfolios): Fashion, beauty, editorial, glamour, headshot and lifestyle work.
- [Services](https://jeffhonforlocophotos.com/services): Photography services and project information.
- [Packages and pricing](https://jeffhonforlocophotos.com/pricing): Current package descriptions and starting prices.
- [Book a session](https://jeffhonforlocophotos.com/book): Select a service, package, preferred date and project details.
- [About Jeff](https://jeffhonforlocophotos.com/about): Photographer background and creative approach.
- [Journal](https://jeffhonforlocophotos.com/journal): Session preparation and photography guidance.
- [Contact](https://jeffhonforlocophotos.com/contact): Direct project inquiry form.

## Browser-agent tools

The site registers four WebMCP tools where the browser supports WebMCP:

- `ask_site`: returns at most three excerpts from published site information.
- `find_service`: matches needs and budget to up to three published options.
- `explore_portfolio`: opens a requested published portfolio or service gallery.
- `prepare_booking`: creates a reversible booking draft for human review; it never submits, reserves a date, sends email or charges a visitor.
